subject: Call reschedule due to audio issue
text: Hello, I need to reschedule our afternoon call. My laptop is losing the microphone permission each time I join, and I do not want to leave you listening to silence. Could we move it to Thursday at 11:30? That time works better for me, and I will test the audio beforehand. I apologize for the change and appreciate your flexibility. If another slot suits you, let me know.
